strings.text: The night here is longer than it seems.
strings.translation: Ici, la nuit est plus longue qu’il n’y paraît.

strings.text: The glade is quiet. So quiet you can hear the mushrooms grow.
strings.translation: La clairière est silencieuse. Si silencieuse qu’on entend pousser les champignons.

strings.text: Someone is waiting by the stream. Has been for a long time.
strings.translation: Quelqu’un attend près du ruisseau. Depuis longtemps.
